# Build Icons

Icons are auto-generated by `scripts/generate-icons.js` using sharp.

## Quick Generate

```bash
npm run generate-icons
# or
node scripts/generate-icons.js
# or
bash scripts/generate-icons.sh
```

## Generated Files

| File | Platform | Size |
|------|----------|------|
| `build/icon.icns` | macOS | Multi-size (128–1024) |
| `build/icon.ico` | Windows | Multi-size (16–256) |
| `build/icon.png` | Base | 1024×1024 |
| `build/icons/icon.png` | Linux | 512×512 |
| `build/icons/icon-16.png` | Linux | 16×16 |
| `build/icons/icon-32.png` | Linux | 32×32 |
| `build/icons/icon-64.png` | Linux | 64×64 |
| `build/icons/icon-128.png` | Linux | 128×128 |
| `build/icons/icon-256.png` | Linux | 256×256 |
| `build/icons/icon-512.png` | Linux | 512×512 |

## Custom Logo

To use a custom logo, edit the `LOGO_SVG` variable in `scripts/generate-icons.js`
and re-run the generator.

## Notes

- Icons are generated from an inline SVG (ghost with gear motif)
- sharp handles all PNG resizing and format conversion
- ICO and ICNS are built via manual binary construction (no external tools needed)
- electron-builder expects these exact paths under `build/`
